lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Anand says she called out Russian counterpart invited by U.S. to G20 ministerial, The Canadian Press reports.
Canada, European Union close Montreal summit with ‘alliance for the future’ pact, CP24 reports.

The planned Roberts Bank Terminal 2 expansion, which is expected to add 2.4 million containers of capacity at the Port of Vancouver, the largest in the country, has officially been named a project of national interest, The Canadian Press reports.

Some Backstreet Boys fans attending one of the group’s Toronto shows aren’t happy with their seat change after Live Nation relocated fans who unknowingly bought tickets that had an obstructed view, CBC News reports.
What to know about the $6.3B hack on Binance, likely the biggest-ever crypto theft, The Associated Press reports.
Judge orders DOJ to stop trying to "intimidate" California election officials, CBS News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
